subject.title: fix(agents): pass attemptNumber instead of apiKeyIndex to retry callbacks (#102938)

question: Should the public `attempt` callback field remain supported indefinitely as the key-index alias, or should OpenClaw begin a formal deprecation and removal lifecycle?
rationale: The helper is exported through the public provider plugin runtime, so declaring its existing field deprecated is an API-lifecycle decision rather than a local implementation detail.

options.title: Keep `attempt` supported
options.body: Remove the deprecation annotation, document it as the existing key-index alias, and add the two unambiguous fields additively.

options.title: Approve formal deprecation
options.body: Retain the annotation only with an explicit compatibility window, migration documentation, focused SDK tests, and a named removal plan.

recommendation.title: Keep `attempt` supported
recommendation.body: Remove the deprecation annotation, document it as the existing key-index alias, and add the two unambiguous fields additively.

likelyOwner.reason: Introduced the public rotation helper and its callback contract in the original merged feature.
